liveFeeds.title: Government & Public Affairs — Spectrum 53
liveFeeds.shortDescription: Live stream of Akakū Channel 53 — Maui County Council, boards and commissions, gavel to gavel.
liveFeeds.longDescription: Akakū Maui Community Media's Government & Public Affairs channel (Spectrum 53), carrying live and recorded Maui County Council meetings, Planning Commission hearings, boards and commissions, and other civic programming. 24-hour live simulcast of the cable broadcast.

liveFeeds.title: All Access All The Time — Spectrum 54
liveFeeds.shortDescription: Live stream of Akakū Channel 54 — community-made shows, all the time.
liveFeeds.longDescription: Akakū Maui Community Media's All Access All The Time channel (Spectrum 54), carrying community-made shows produced by Akakū members from across Maui County. 24-hour live simulcast of the cable broadcast.

liveFeeds.title: Live & Local — Spectrum 55
liveFeeds.shortDescription: Live stream of Akakū Channel 55 — local shows and live community events from Maui.
liveFeeds.longDescription: Akakū Maui Community Media's Live & Local channel (Spectrum 55), carrying local shows and live community events from across Maui County. 24-hour live simulcast of the cable broadcast.
